name: steward
description: The project's living-model keeper — the guy behind the inbox. Per project it maintains a rich model (.steward/: vision, state, parts+contracts, open questions, next tasks) and an inbox your stray thoughts land in. On every input it RECOMPUTES the whole model (adds/edits/deletes, cascades pivots) and shows you the diff, so you always know where the ship is and why. Interface is ambient — zero commands to remember: opening the project auto-briefs you (SessionStart hook, silent in projects without a model), talking normally captures ideas, plain words drive work ('what's next', 'do it'), session leftovers integrate at next open. Slash commands (/steward:seed|brief|sync|next) are optional aliases only. Work happens only while you watch — the steward never moves code or the model in your absence (inbox staging only). Carries a hook — install standalone, not part of the mk-cc-all bundle. 0.7.0: the GARDEN — a nightly pass (owner ruling 2026-09-18: one live copy, a contradiction keeps the LATEST input, nothing kept forever) that deletes by date (old log entries, archived digests, integrated inbox files, inbox/done) and has the agent replace contradicted claims, delete stale ones, resolve expired questions to their default and cut over-cap files, with a kept/replaced/deleted diff; /steward:garden on demand, thresholds in .steward/garden.json.
